ownerReportedFailure: An automatic native pointer and action badge rendered over an unrelated focused window during background work.
ownerChosenBehavior: Expose feedback only inside uncovered portions of the actual background task window, while leaving the focused owner window clear.
changes: Normal-level, exact-window rendering instead of screen-saver/all-Spaces planes
Pixel clipping for normal occluders and the focused owner window; higher layers use WindowServer stacking
App/window scope inherited across delayed animation callbacks
Short expiry, hidden empty windows and a stopped idle animation timer
Dismissal invalidates delayed feedback; display geometry is checked before rebuilding planes
Passive diagnostics and scoped cursor commands across MCP, CLI and JavaScript

validation.initialInstalledCheck: Geometry, cover/uncover, dismissal and expiry checks completed; a foreground transition between owner apps made the final focus-preservation assertion inconclusive. A subsequent check passed with the foreground unchanged.

limits: The renderer samples window geometry at up to 20 Hz and uses native focus/Space notifications; it is not a hard real-time guarantee.
Window bounds are rectangular; unusual translucent or custom windows may make feedback more conservative.
This is visual cooperation, not universal app input isolation.
A changed ad-hoc signature can require fresh macOS consent.

installedNativePermissions.scope: Visual rendering does not request these permissions; native input/capture still requires macOS consent.
